GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004 (24 Dec 46) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN - 1418)
APO 500
24 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Protection and Preservation of the Property of Standard Vacuum Oil Company.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 600.3 (30 Nov 46)CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1370, 30 November 1946, subject, "Preservation of Property in Japan Owned by United Nations and Their Nationals", from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers;
b. LO 2118(SF/FP), 8 November 1946, subject, "Protection of Allied Property", from the Ministry of Finance, Imperial Japanese Government.
2. In view of the terms of reference 1a, the separate application for the release of funds from the Standard Vacuum Oil Company account to cover the expense of wiring Standard Vacuum Oil Company property submitted under reference 1b is hereby denied.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
